clue.text: Bold sort of band?

definitions.meaning: brazen or cheeky, as in having the nerve or 'neck' to do something
a band of trumpets, trombones and tubas, as in the colliery bands of northern England

explanation.surface: A question about what makes a musical group bold.
explanation.definitionFit: Brass neck means impudence, and a band of horns and cornets is named after the metal of its instruments.

clue.text: Growing up in Kentucky in tattered rags in the depression

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the middle of the other

parts.note: the blues is a mood of low spirits or depression

indicators.note: tattered things are torn apart, so the word rags is rearranged

explanation.surface: A child raised in Kentucky poverty, in rags during the Depression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tattered' scrambles the four letters of 'rags', and 'in' sets them inside the musical name for low spirits. 'Growing up' looks like a childhood, but it means a plant that grows.
explanation.definitionFit: Kentucky is nicknamed after a meadow grass with a bluish tinge that grows there.

clue.text: Sycorax's prisoner." pined " for twelve years

definitions.text: Sycorax's prisoner." pined " for twelve years

parts.words: Sycorax's prisoner." pined " for twelve years
parts.note: in The Tempest the witch Sycorax shut a spirit inside a cloven pine tree for twelve years; 'pined' puns on that

explanation.surface: A prisoner of a witch languished for twelve years.
explanation.walkthrough: In Shakespeare's The Tempest, Prospero frees the sprite from the pine where Sycorax had trapped it; 'pined' means both longed and enclosed in pine.
explanation.definitionFit: The airy spirit in The Tempest was imprisoned in a pine by the witch Sycorax.

clue.text: Cup-sets broken up. Whodunnit, think you?

indicators.note: broken up means the letters of cup-sets are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Broken crockery prompts a detective to ask who did it.
explanation.definitionFit: The person a detective believes committed the crime is the prime candidate for guilt.

clue.text: Sack the president — for child mobilization ?

parts.note: to sack someone is to give them the push, so sack means push
the chair of a meeting is the person presiding over it

explanation.surface: Firing the head of state as a call to get children moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mobilization' looks military, but it is literal: making a child mobile in a wheeled seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A folding wheeled seat is what parents use to move a small child about.

clue.text: Take off wages without corporal punishment

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so one piece is wrapped around the other

parts.note: wages are pay
the rod, a cane for beating, stands for corporal punishment

explanation.surface: Removing pay as an alternative to caning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To take someone off is to mimic them for comic effect, a send-up.

clue.text: Moonlight activity of a branch railway?

definitions.meaning: moonlighting is doing a second job on the side
a minor track off the main route, a line to the side

explanation.surface: A spare-time job on a minor railway route.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra work alongside a main job, and whimsically a track branching off to the side.

clue.text: Pythian pronouncement follows about an old boat

indicators.note: follows means the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: c is short for circa, Latin for about
the Pythia was the priestess at Delphi whose prophecies were given there

explanation.surface: A Delphic prophecy concerns an ancient vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round boat of wicker and hide is an ancient type of craft.

clue.text: Married brothers inter alia cooked such delicious food

indicators.note: to inter is to bury, so one piece is put inside the other
cooked means the letters are mixed up like ingredients

explanation.surface: Married brothers among others prepared a delicious feast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inter' buries M and BROS in ALIA, and 'cooked' rearranges the lot. 'inter alia' looks like the Latin 'among other things'.
explanation.definitionFit: Food fit for the gods of myth, ambrosia, describes anything wonderfully tasty.

clue.text: Circles squared for some fighters

definitions.meaning: boxing and wrestling take place in a square enclosure still called by the circular name

explanation.surface: Boxers fight in circles that have been made square.
explanation.definitionFit: Round loops share the name of the square boxing arena, a paradox the clue plays on.

clue.text: Wandering nude round ruins maybe, without cover

indicators.note: one set of letters goes round the other, enclosing it
wandering letters stray from their places, so the word nude is rearranged
maybe suggests a possible version, so the word ruins is also rearranged

explanation.surface: A naked rambler strolling round ancient remains, perhaps without clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wandering' and 'maybe' each signal a rearrangement, and 'round' puts the shuffled naked word around the shuffled remains. 'Cover' seems to mean clothing for the nude, but it is insurance cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with no policy has no insurance protection, so they lack cover.

clue.text: Bird may be round with a petition

definitions.text: may be round with a petition
definitions.meaning: a round-... is a petition with signatures arranged in a circle so no name heads the list

explanation.surface: A bird might go round collecting signatures.
explanation.definitionFit: The garden songbird shares its name with the second half of round-robin, a circular petition.

clue.text: 1980's apple of discord — of same classical hue

definitions.text: 1980's apple of discord — of same classical hue

parts.words: 1980's apple of discord — of same classical hue
parts.note: the apple of discord thrown by Eris was golden; a popular modern eating apple shares that colour in its name

explanation.surface: A topical eating apple is linked to the golden apple of Greek myth.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Eris threw a golden apple marked 'for the fairest', starting the quarrel that led to the Trojan War; the cultivated apple in the answer has the same colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A widely grown yellow eating apple variety carries the colour of the mythical apple Eris threw.

clue.text: Shrewd as Numa's tutelary spirit herein

indicators.note: herein says the answer is contained within the following words of the clue

explanation.surface: A comparison of shrewdness with the nymph who guided the Roman king Numa.
explanation.walkthrough: Numa Pompilius, early king of Rome, was said to be guided by the nymph Egeria; the answer sits across 'Numa's tutelary'.
explanation.definitionFit: Clever and sharp in judging situations, as a canny person is.

clue.text: Informed about a tree's destruction, suffered

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: to have informed someone is to have told them

indicators.note: destruction wrecks the words a tree and reassembles them

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Someone was told about a tree being felled and endured it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destruction' scrambles the letters of 'a tree' (the possessive adds nothing) into ERATE, and 'about' wraps the past tense of 'inform' around them.
explanation.definitionFit: To have put up with something is to have endured or allowed it.

clue.text: Conclude one heraldic colour is substandard

parts.note: to conclude from evidence is to infer
the Roman numeral for one
or is the heraldic term for gold

explanation.surface: Deciding that a coat of arms' colour is not up to scratch.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of lower quality than expected is poorer than standard.

clue.text: Persistent lover's suit so restrained?

parts.note: a wooer's suit pressed again and again, or a suit of clothes ironed again, could be held down

explanation.surface: A determined suitor's courtship is held in check.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suit' means both a courtship pressed on someone and clothing pressed with an iron; split, the answer reads pressed again.
explanation.definitionFit: Held back or kept under control describes feelings pushed down.

clue.text: Like unnamed bureaucrats, not featured

definitions.meaning: anonymous officials are criticised as having no identity
lacking features, the parts of a face

explanation.surface: Officials without names lack character.
explanation.definitionFit: Anonymous officials lack identity, and having no features means lacking a face.

clue.text: Drummer died dramatically

definitions.meaning: American slang for a travelling sales rep who drums up business
Arthur Miller's play about Willy Loman is Death of a ... , so this figure dies on stage

explanation.surface: A percussionist met a theatrical end.
explanation.definitionFit: A drummer is a commercial traveller, and Arthur Miller's tragedy shows the death of one.

clue.text: A spot with Holmes's band

parts.note: a small dot; Conan Doyle's story The Adventure of the ... Band adds a D to it

explanation.surface: A detective's spotted band.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sherlock Holmes story 'The Adventure of the Speckled Band' gives the band; a small spot names the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small mark or fleck of colour is a dot.

clue.text: Do students work with the lump?

parts.note: taken as written
L is the learner driver's plate, so two learners or students give LL
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Asking whether students study alongside a dull, stolid classmate.
explanation.definitionFit: A blob or large spoonful of something soft is a shapeless mass.

clue.text: Soldiers queer before the start of the scrap

indicators.note: before means the first pieces come ahead of the next

parts.note: queer in its old sense of strange or odd
men are soldiers, as opposed to officers

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Strange troops waiting for a fight to begin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrap' looks like a fight, but it is a leftover piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A leftover piece or remnant, such as a fabric offcut.

clue.text: Fire bell sound raised in one quarter

indicators.note: in means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
e for east, one of the four quarters of the compass

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means read from bottom to top

parts.note: ting is the light ringing sound of a small bell

explanation.surface: A fire bell sounds in one part of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns the bell's ring upwards in this down clue, and 'in' sets it between the numeral and the compass point. 'Fire' looks like a noun, but it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To set alight is to make something catch.

clue.text: Contest which two are bound to enter

definitions.text: Contest which two are bound to enter

parts.words: Contest which two are bound to enter
parts.note: a sports-day event in which pairs run with one leg each tied to the partner's

explanation.surface: A competition that two parties are obliged to take part in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' seems to mean obliged, but the two runners are literally tied together at the ankle.
explanation.definitionFit: In this school sports race, partners have adjacent legs tied so they hobble along on three.

clue.text: Turned up excellent portion of bone

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the joined words are read upwards

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI
a bit is a portion

explanation.surface: An excellent cut of meat on the bone was served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned up' reverses AIBIT to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The shinbone, the larger of the two lower leg bones.

clue.text: No Old Testament character in publicity business

definitions.text: No Old Testament character in publicity business

parts.words: No Old Testament character in publicity business
parts.note: the first man of Genesis almost spells the answer but is not it; the real one works in advertising

explanation.surface: No biblical figure works in advertising.
explanation.walkthrough: Adam, the first man in Genesis, is one letter shy of the answer, so the person here is no Old Testament character but an ad man.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who works in advertising creates promotional campaigns.

clue.text: Christopher and Jack turned to cloth-printing

indicators.note: turned means the joined names are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: Kit is a short form of the name Christopher
a jack or jack tar is a sailor, abbreviated AB for able seaman

explanation.surface: Two men took up a craft of printing fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' reverses KITAB to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This Javanese technique dyes fabric with wax-resist patterns, a method of decorating cloth.

clue.text: Everybody included in this unusually prime side

indicators.note: unusually means the words prime side are arranged in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A statement about everyone being on a strangely excellent team.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on everyone's body being wrapped in this outer layer of skin.
explanation.definitionFit: The outermost layer of skin covers every human body, so all people are enclosed by it.

clue.text: Recipient of goods by post -a golf-ball perhaps?

definitions.meaning: the person a parcel or letter is sent to
a golfer addresses the ball by taking up a stance before striking it

explanation.surface: A person receiving mail compared with a golf ball.
explanation.definitionFit: The person a letter is directed to, and a golf ball being lined up by a player about to swing.

clue.text: Sweet the sound of engines thus adjusted?

definitions.text: Sweet the sound of engines thus adjusted?

parts.words: Sweet the sound of engines thus adjusted?
parts.note: engines that a mechanic has set up properly run smoothly and sound sweet

explanation.surface: Engines sound sweet after being properly adjusted.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjusting an engine or instrument for best performance is the same as setting it correctly.
